name: INCLUDE
intro: INCLUDE 是面向地域与文化知识的多语言多项选择基准，论文完整集含 197,243 题，来自 1,926 场考试、44 种语言、15 种文字和 52 个国家。数据由母语社区从学术、职业认证和地区执照考试中收集、抽取与质检，并结合既有多语言考试集，随后标注学科、层级、国家与地域性，形成完整集及标准化的 BASE/LITE 子集。
org: EPFL, Cohere For AI, Cohere For AI Community, ETH Zurich, Swiss AI Initiative
build_method: 母语社区收集考试，多格式抽取，母语者质检、过滤并做考试级元数据与地域性标注
metric: Accuracy, answer accuracy, formatting error rate
eval_feature: 地域知识、跨语言提示、5-shot 与零样本思维链
build_method_en: Native-community exam collection, multi-format extraction, native-speaker quality control, filtering, and exam-level metadata and regionality annotation
eval_feature_en: Regional knowledge, cross-language prompts, five-shot and zero-shot chain of thought
intro_en: INCLUDE is a multilingual multiple-choice benchmark for regional and cultural knowledge. The paper's complete set contains 197,243 questions from 1,926 examinations, 44 languages, 15 scripts, and 52 countries. Native-language communities collect, extract, and quality-check academic, professional-certification, and regional-license exams; the project also consolidates existing multilingual exam datasets, annotates subject, level, country, and regionality, and derives standardized BASE and LITE subsets.
metric_en: Accuracy, answer accuracy, formatting error rate

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.19799. The paper's full INCLUDE release contains 197,243 MCQA pairs from 1,926 examinations, 44 languages, 15 scripts, 52 countries, and 58 knowledge domains. Native-speaker communities collect academic exams, professional certifications, and regional licenses. PDF, JavaScript/HTML, and other extraction pipelines produce questions, options, and correct answers; native speakers compare them with originals, correct errors, remove image/table-dependent items, preserve required reference context, and label language, topic, level, and country. The exact accounting is 118,606 newly parsed and verified questions plus 78,637 questions from ArabicMMLU, ChineseMMLU, TurkishMMLU, PersianMMLU, VNHSGE, and EXAMS. Exams receive a two-level academic taxonomy and regionality labels: agnostic 34.4%, explicit 18.8%, cultural 16.4%, and implicit 30.4%. The paper subsets contain BASE 22,635 and LITE 10,770 four-option MCQAs; the current BASE-44 dataset card reports 22,637, so the diagram deliberately preserves the paper snapshot. Evaluation compares five-shot and zero-shot chain of thought using in-language or English prompts, with optional region prefixes, and reports accuracy plus answer-accuracy and formatting-error analyses.
